none: PAS NLM-02C1F8: Roman Coin: Siliqua, possibly of Honorius
contea di ritrovamento: Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)

Silver Coin. Siliqua of Honorius (393-423) as identified by the finder, Reece period 21. Obverse description: Bust diademed draped and cuirassed right. Obverse inscription: [--]NORI[--]. Reverse description: Seated figure, probably Roma, facing holding spear and Victory. Reverse inscription: [--]MAN[--]. Diameter: 12.3mm, Weight: 0.77gms, die axis: 12
